title: Account support: unlock, disable, enable, reset two-factor
caption: Mirrors admin-signin.e2e.ts. Never reset MFA only because someone asks: identity check first (runbook §6).

steps.title: Find the account
steps.body: Search by part of the e-mail or name; open the account.
steps.expect: Fields, active session count, memberships with OTA status and role, last 50 audit rows, links to the audit log by actor and by target.

steps.title: Unlock
steps.body: After 5 wrong portal passwords the page shows 'Locked until …'. **Unlock** → **Unlock account** (no reason).
steps.expect: 'The account is unlocked.' and 'Not locked'; the next sign-in reaches the code step.

steps.title: Disable and enable
steps.expect: Disabled sign-ins answer `ACCOUNT_DISABLED`; sessions revoked and `staffdeny:acct:<id>` written; enable restores sign-in (revoked sessions stay revoked).

steps.title: Reset two-factor
steps.body: **Reset two-factor** → reason that says how identity was checked → **Reset two-factor authentication** → code.
steps.expect: 'Two-factor authentication is turned off for this account, and the person got an e-mail.'; e-mail about two-factor in Mailpit; the next sign-in needs no code. Not offered for platform admins.
